name: gmod-mcp
description: MCP server for Garry's Mod: Lua in every realm, maps, console, errors, screenshots and hook tracing.
long_description:
gmod-mcp-bridge, the stdio side of gmod-mcp. It relays to the gmod-mcp module running inside Garry's Mod, stays connected while the game is closed (every tool then answers `game_not_running`) and tells the client when the game is back.

**The module for the game is a separate install** (two files, in the game folder): see the Install section of the README. The game must run with the launch option `-mcp`. Everything stays on your machine (127.0.0.1, bearer token read from a file under your user profile).

Windows and Linux (x86-64) only.

feedback_offers.title: Offer to report frictions
feedback_offers.description: On (default): at the end of a task, agents may offer to report the frictions they met with gmod-mcp as a public GitHub issue (no secrets or project data; you agree to each one). Off: they never ask.
